description:
The commute, sorted
No queue, no timetable, no traffic to sit in. RHeO 2 is the easy answer – a lightweight eBike built for the commute, start to finish.

Bosch's Hub Line motor sits quietly in the rear wheel, so from the outside it's just a normal bike. Four power modes take the effort out of hills, and the 360Wh battery, hidden in the frame, gives you up to 72km* on a charge.

Integrated lights mean you're seen whatever time you set off. Add our after-market RHeO mudguards whenever the weather turns, and you're sorted. It's built by Whyte, an award-winning British mountain bike brand, so you know it's built to last.

Some mornings you'll queue for the bus. Some mornings you won't. RHeO. Let your everyday flow.

Highlights
– Lightweight aluminium frame: 17.4kg (size M) — easy to carry up the stairs. Available in step-through (RHeO 2 ST) and standard (RHeO 2).
– Bosch Hub Line motor: discreet rear-hub power – up to 400W peak, 45Nm torque – with four power modes: turbo, auto, tour and eco.
– 360Wh internal Bosch battery: real, usable everyday range – 33-72km (20-44 miles)*. Full charge in 3.5 hours.
– Integrated lights: front and rear, built in, so you're seen whatever the hour or the weather.
– Confidence-inspiring handling: built on our Total Geometry approach – low, centred and stable, so every ride just flows.
– Smartly connected: works with Bosch's Smart System and eBike Flow app for navigation, free software updates, and more.
– Peace of mind: covered by our lifetime frame and fork warranty* plus two-year Bosch eBike system warranty**.
– Built to add to: compatible with Whyte's RHeO mudguards for year-round wet-weather protection, sold separately.

*Many variables can affect actual range - including weight, riding style, riding surfaces, support mode, temperature and more. You can use Bosch's range estimator to give you a more specific range estimation here.
**Register for free within 28-days of purchase to activate here.
